notes.title: Price Reduction
notes.content:
Hello !

In order to let more people have an easier way to enjoy the thrill of driving tanks and blasting everything in the path. 
We have decided to lower the selling price.

Let's fire everything!

notes.title: Play more casually
notes.content:
Hello

In order to let everyone enjoy the game more, we have made the following adjustments:

[list]
[*]Reduced vehicle purchase costs.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Increased Arcade bonus time after clearing a stage.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Adjusted achievements, lowering the completion requirements.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added progress display for achievements.
[/list]

Let's fire everything.

notes.title: Fixed some bugs.
notes.content:
We have been gradually fixing some errors during this period.
[list]
[*]Incorrect total distance record.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Press fire button also break when use gamepad.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Text disappears in some resolutions.
[/list]

Also, add new tips and bonus when reaching the goal in arcade mode to enhance everyone's enjoyment of the game.

Let's fire everything.

notes.title: 《Run Tank Run》 Available Now

Hello!!

"Run Tank Run" is Available Now!
Drive your tank, blast everything blocking your way, and rush forward with exhilaration.

notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
Hello

The release date for "Run Tank Run" has been announced!!
We are excited to let you know that the game will be released on October 20, 2023, at 12:00 (PDT). 
For those who have been following us, you will be able to play soon. And for those who are new to us, don't miss the opportunity to try out the demo in the Next Fest.

Let's Fire Everything!

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!

Run Tank Run has joined Steam Nest Fest and released demo,
Feel free to experience the exhilarating thrill of firing and dashing.

We will also announce the game release date within the next few days.
Please stay tuned.

Let's Fire Everything!
